text.bouncemod.screen.title: Squash Mod Settings
text.bouncemod.language.tooltip: Language of this screen. 'Auto' follows the game language. (Reopen the screen to apply!)
text.bouncemod.bpm.tooltip: Beats per minute - how fast entities squash.
text.bouncemod.amplitude.tooltip: How strong the squash is. 0 = off, 5 = extreme.
text.bouncemod.volume.tooltip: Volume of the bounce music (0 to 1).
text.bouncemod.range.tooltip: Max distance for entities to squash.
